column1: # Chinese patient language -> ICPC-3 S component. OUR writing, Apache-2.0.
# NOT a translation of ICPC-3. The classification is CC BY-ND and a translated
# term list would be a derivative work we may not publish. Every left-hand
# side here is a phrase a person types into a symptom log; the right-hand side
# is our judgement about which code it points at. Display names stay in
# ICPC-3's English, which is why there is no third column holding a Chinese
# Two sentinels instead of a code:
#   !too-broad   names a family, not a complaint. Never answered.
#   !ambiguous   names two complaints. A person can say which; we cannot.
# Matching is exact over translate.fold.name_key, so write the surface as a
# person types it and add one row per spelling. No suffix stripping, no
# substring search: 肚子疼 and 肚子痛 are two rows on purpose.
